notes.subject: A ka kgetha
notes.rationale: כרת e bolela 'go kgaola' — go kgaola kgwerano; ba bangwe ba fetolela 'go dira', Sepedi se boloka sebopego sa go kgaola ka 'go kgetha'

notes.subject: wa ka narie
notes.rationale: עולם e bolela nako yeo e ka se kopane — 'ya phelošego' goba 'ya ka narie'; 'ka narie' e swanela sebopego sa khutso

notes.subject: go Jobe
notes.rationale: Potšišo e tswalana le ya temana ye e fetilego, e ya go Jobe ka tlhomo

translation: A ka kgetha le wena kgwerano, gore o mo tšere ⟨את⟩ go ba mohlanka wa ka narie?
